text.original: Party Wall: It includes a. A wall forming part of a building, and being used or constructed to be used in any part of the height or length of such wall for separation or adorning buildings belonging to different owners or occupied or constructed or adapted to be occupied by different persons; or b. A wall forming part of a building and standing in any part of the length of such wall, to a greater extent than the projection of the footing on one side on grounds of different owners.
